<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR showing a single multiplet at 7.51 ppm integrating to 10 aromatic protons, the most parsimonious structure is biphenyl (C₁₂H₁₀). This matches the integration and typical chemical shift for aromatic hydrogens. The SMILES for biphenyl is "c1ccccc1-c2ccccc2".</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1-c2ccccc2</final_answer>
